Definition: from G719; to joint, i.e. (figuratively) to woo (reflexively, to betroth):--espouse.
BiblicalUsage: Harmozo means to join together, to betroth, and Paul uses it once, for the church itself. In 2 Corinthians 11:2 he says he has espoused the Corinthians to one husband, that he may present them as a chaste virgin to Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the marriage picture is the tenderest one Paul ever uses for the church: we are not hired hands, we are a bride, and he is jealous for us with a godly jealousy.
